highlights: Need a compact, efficient and safe car charger? Joyroom JR-CCN16 Mini 15W is a great choice for every driver who values ​​fast charging and functionality.
Its small size means that the charger fits perfectly into the cigarette lighter socket and does not protrude beyond its edge.
The 15W power allows you to effectively renew the energy of your smartphone, tablet or other mobile devices.
Dual USB-A and USB-C ports allow you to charge two devices simultaneously, and the advanced protection system ensures full safety during use.
The solid and fireproof housing guarantees long life, and CE, RoHS and FCC certificates confirm the highest quality of the product.
